verdict: A clean sign-in form built solely from real bl-input/bl-button elements with valid attributes (type, autocomplete, required, variant, type=submit) and no hallucinated tags; semantic main/h1 plus an aria-live status region are good. It falls short of the idiomatic Baklava pattern by using external <label for> instead of bl-input's label attribute (weak shadow-DOM label association) and by only validating the email field while bypassing password/component validation, so it scores below the augmented arm.
